_comment: The decision table. Each case is ONE tool call (or memory operation) the agent's model has already proposed. The lab does not simulate a model or any attack text: it only asks the twins what each control decides. 'screen' says how Model Armor would classify the tool response the proposal came from ('injection-like' = the kind of text a prompt-injection filter is built to flag; 'ordinary' = reads like a normal customer request, which a classifier may let through). 'source_tool' names the tool whose response the proposal came from; Model Armor on the gateway screens that response. 'id_token' is what the front end verified (data/directory.json maps it to one user); 'end_user' is that user, and 'request_user_id' is what the request body claims. Hosts and mailboxes are on documentation domains (RFC 2606).
